outcomes.label: plain reverse holo (any Common/Uncommon/Rare, equal chance per card)

models.notes: TCGplayer Authentication Center sample: >5,000 packs. 95% CI: DR +/-1.12, UR +/-0.76, IR +/-0.86, SIR +/-0.27, MHR 0.08 +/-0.08 (CI as wide as the estimate; 2 MHR cards, 1 in 1,260 for either, 1 in 2,520 for a specific one). . Mega-era rarities: Mega Hyper Rare replaces Hyper Rare; the 'Rare' (non-ex holo) cards are Holofoil with a separate Reverse Holofoil printing. MHR slot is not stated by TCGplayer; it is placed in the second reverse-holo (hit) slot following the Scarlet & Violet pattern (does not change EV). Slot layout (TCGplayer/Pokemon): 4 Common + 3 Uncommon + 2 reverse-holo slots + 1 rare slot = 10 cards; the official pack text is '10 cards, 1 Basic Energy, 1 TCG Live code card' so the Basic Energy and code card are extra and are NOT modeled (worth ~$0). Rates are TCGplayer Authentication Center 'any card of that rarity per pack' values (95% CI in notes). Within a rarity all cards are assumed equally likely (TCGplayer found each card inside the CI of an equal share). Plain reverse-holo outcomes are assumed to pick uniformly across all Common/Uncommon/Rare cards that have a Reverse Holofoil price (no published rarity mix for that slot). Slot assignment follows TCGplayer's text ('Double/Ultra Rare in the Rare slot'; 'Illustration/Special Illustration/Hyper Rare in the second Reverse Holo slot'). God packs / Demigod packs are not included in any rate.

outcomes.label: any reverse-holo printing: 'Energy Symbol Pattern', ball patterns ((Poke|Love|Friend|Quick|Dusk) Ball, (Team Rocket)) or plain trainer reverse; equal chance per card is an ASSUMPTION

outcomes.label: any reverse-holo printing: 'Energy Symbol Pattern', ball patterns ((Poke|Love|Friend|Quick|Dusk) Ball, (Team Rocket)) or plain trainer reverse; equal chance per card is an ASSUMPTION

models.notes: TCGplayer Authentication Center, >2,000 packs (God packs excluded; none found). 95% CI: DR +/-1.70, UR +/-0.90, Mega Attack Rare +/-0.77, IR +/-1.33, SIR +/-0.50, MHR 0.19 +/-0.18. The article's UR detail section prints '20.77%' but its summary table, the '1 in 21' figure and the text ('~5%') all say 4.81%, so 4.81% is used. Mega Attack Rare replaces an Ultra Rare in the rare slot (UR is ~8% in other Mega sets). There is NO Master Ball pattern in Ascended Heroes. Instead every non-ex Pokemon C/U/R has TWO reverse printings: 'Energy Symbol Pattern' and a ball pattern (Poke Ball, Love Ball, Friend Ball, Quick Ball, Dusk Ball, or Team Rocket 'R'); Trainer/Special Energy C/U have one plain Reverse Holofoil printing. These are separate TCGplayer products (names end with '(Energy Symbol Pattern)', '(Poke Ball)', '(Love Ball)', ...) with finish Reverse Holofoil. NO source gives how often each pattern or the two reverse slots produce them; the model assumes both reverse slots draw uniformly from all C/U/R Reverse Holofoil products. A PokeBeach post (not retrievable here) reportedly says IR/SIR/MHR may appear in either reverse slot in the digital game; TCGplayer says second reverse slot; EV is unaffected. God packs (3 Mega Attack Rare + 7 SIR) exist, rate unknown (community guesses 1 in 1,500-4,000), NOT included. Slot layout (TCGplayer/Pokemon): 4 Common + 3 Uncommon + 2 reverse-holo slots + 1 rare slot = 10 cards; the official pack text is '10 cards, 1 Basic Energy, 1 TCG Live code card' so the Basic Energy and code card are extra and are NOT modeled (worth ~$0). Rates are TCGplayer Authentication Center 'any card of that rarity per pack' values (95% CI in notes). Within a rarity all cards are assumed equally likely (TCGplayer found each card inside the CI of an equal share). Plain reverse-holo outcomes are assumed to pick uniformly across all Common/Uncommon/Rare cards that have a Reverse Holofoil price (no published rarity mix for that slot). Slot assignment follows TCGplayer's text ('Double/Ultra Rare in the Rare slot'; 'Illustration/Special Illustration/Hyper Rare in the second Reverse Holo slot'). notes: Pokemon (English) pack models built 2026-10-20. PRIMARY SOURCE for nearly every number: TCGplayer Authentication Center pull-rate articles (one per set, 350 to 8,500+ packs, per-pack 'any card of this rarity' with 95% CI), retrieved through the JSON endpoint behind the page (infinite-api.tcgplayer.com/content/article/<uuid>/; the HTML pages are JavaScript-only). Raw JSON saved under raw-pull/infinite-api.tcgplayer.com/. These are NOT official Pokemon Company odds (none exist). SEMANTICS: an outcome's card pool = cards of the named set with rarity in the 'rarity' list AND a price row with the given 'finish' (TCGplayer subTypeName) AND product name matching name_regex (if present) AND NOT matching exclude_name_regex (if present); cards_from_set means use that other TCGplayer group instead of the model's set; every pool card is assumed equally likely; p values in each slot sum to 1; slot expected value = count x sum_p x mean market price of the pool. Extra optional keys beyond the spec: label, cards_from_set, exclude_name_regex. STRUCTURE (Scarlet & Violet and Mega Evolution eras, per tcg.pokemon.com and TCGplayer): 10 cards = 4 Common + 3 Uncommon + reverse-holo slot 1 + reverse-holo slot 2 + rare slot, plus 1 Basic Energy and 1 code card that are not modeled. Double Rare / Ultra Rare / Mega Attack Rare live in the rare slot; Illustration Rare, Special Illustration Rare, Hyper Rare / Mega Hyper Rare, Master Ball (Prismatic Evolutions) and Black White Rare live in reverse slot 2; ACE SPEC, Poke Ball / Master Ball (Black Bolt, White Flare), Shiny Rare / Shiny Ultra Rare (Paldean Fates) live in reverse slot 1. FINISHES verified on tcgcsv price rows for ME01, PRE, PAF and ASC: Common/Uncommon = Normal and Reverse Holofoil; Rare = Holofoil and Reverse Holofoil; every hit rarity = Holofoil; Poke/Master Ball Pattern products (PRE, BLK, WHT) = Holofoil; Ascended Heroes pattern products = Reverse Holofoil. Other sets assumed identical. EXACT LABELS verified from tcgcsv product lists: Common, Uncommon, Rare, Double Rare, Ultra Rare, Illustration Rare, Special Illustration Rare, Hyper Rare, Mega Hyper Rare, Mega Attack Rare, ACE SPEC Rare, Shiny Rare, Shiny Ultra Rare, Black White Rare, Pikachu Rare, Futuristic Rare, RGB Rare, Classic Collection (separate group), Code Card (ignore). Prismatic Evolutions has no Illustration Rare. TCGPLAYER INTERNAL INCONSISTENCIES RESOLVED: Ascended Heroes UR detail 20.77% vs 4.81% (used 4.81); Prismatic Evolutions DR detail 16.94% vs summary 16.51% (used 16.51); Perfect Order and Pitch Black MHR table vs text; Black Bolt/White Flare article text names Destined Rivals. REJECTED SOURCES: tcgwatchtower.com set pages show identical Chaos Rising-style numbers for unrelated sets (Mega Evolution, Shrouded Fable, Stellar Crown), TCGTalk 'community estimates' are model assumptions; Card Codex/Wargamer/Deltias only repeat TCGplayer. WEAKEST ASSUMPTIONS: (1) MHR/Hyper-tier rates are tiny and noisy (95% CI as wide as the estimate for ME sets; pooled ME-main MHR = 0.085% per pack, see pokemon-me-main-pooled-fallback); (2) Ascended Heroes reverse-pattern frequencies are unpublished (equal chance per card assumed); (3) Shrouded Fable is a pure estimate; (4) Black White Rare 0.2% per pack is an estimate; (5) mix of Common/Uncommon/Rare inside plain reverse-holo slots is unpublished (equal per card); (6) 30th Celebration slots 1-2 and non-hit remainders are guessed; (7) SWSH structure and labels verified only for Silver Tempest, Rare vs Holo Rare split estimated, Evolving Skies unverified; (8) god-pack / demigod-pack rates (Ascended Heroes, Prismatic Evolutions, 151, Paldean Fates...) excluded because unmeasured; (9) ME06 Delta Reign unreleased until 2026-11-06, covered only by the pooled fallback. NOT MODELED: SWSH01-SWSH09 and older, Crown Zenith, Shining Fates, Celebrations, Pokemon GO, Trainer Gallery sub-type pricing, SVE/MEE energy groups, promos.
